title: High Water Flooded Roadway Alarm Warning System
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: Use this service request to report a problem with the high water sign systems if the lights are NOT flashing when water is ON the road and if the lights are still flashing after water has receded. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

observedQuestions.question: What is going on with the warning system?
What is the intersection being reported or the nearest cross street?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

pathCoverage: Both warning-system answers tried; no additional fields revealed.
All three contact-preference answers tried; no additional fields revealed.
Continue advanced to Contact. No contact data entered.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a high-water warning sign system when water is on the road but its lights are not flashing, or when lights continue flashing after water has receded.
actions.why: For a high-water warning sign system when water is on the road but its lights are not flashing, or when lights continue flashing after water has receded. The 311 request asks which warning-system condition applies and for the intersection or nearest cross street.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "High Water Flooded Roadway Alarm Warning System"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "High Water Flooded Roadway Alarm Warning System"
